{"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-17 the payments source sends amount corrections as a repeated txn_id with a higher record_version (28 such rows). silver_transactions keeps both versions, which creates the duplicate keys and double counts in the gold tables. Fix: keep only the latest version of each txn_id, chosen before the POSTED filter so that a stale POSTED v1 does not survive when v2 is REVERSED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM raw_transactions
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1
) r
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
